text:
nisha: Heads-up — PR #4821 updates the Python SDK snippets for the migration guide and fixes a couple of broken links. Planning to merge tomorrow morning but want a quick voice/terminology pass first. Can @laura and @sam take a look?

sam: I can check snippets for code accuracy. Are we enforcing the new terminology rules for this PR? (request id -> request identifier, model -> model_version)

laura: Yes please. Also watch for passive voice in the how-to steps. We prefer imperative tone: 'Run this command' not 'You can run'.

mike: Quick CI note: docs preview failed earlier with a 404 on the anchor for "SDK auth". I left a comment in the PR about the anchor rename.

nisha: Thanks — I fixed the anchor but left the old redirect in case. Also changed the snippet that used `client.generate()` to the new `client.text_generate(model_version=..., input=...)` to match the SDK surface.

emily: Could we standardize the param name in examples to `model_version` across Python/TS? I saw one JS example still using `model`.

laura: Yes. All official snippets must use `model_version`. Add a short callout explaining why (pinning for reproducibility).

sam: I'll run through the Python snippets. If I spot any outdated imports I'll open a small follow-up PR.

docs-bot: [preview] docs-ci.redwood.ai/builds/4821 — preview deployed (staging). Status: failed linkcheck.

nisha: Linkcheck failure was the internal anchor, that's fixed. Re-ran the preview and it passed locally for me but CI still reports failure; might be caching.

mike: CI sometimes caches the old redirect. I can trigger a clean build if we want to merge after approvals.

laura: One more style nit: examples that show error handling should use the same pattern. We use `try/except` in Python and `try/catch` in JS with a short comment about transient 429s and retry backoff.

nisha: Good catch. I'll add an example snippet for retries. Proposed Python retry snippet:

```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=KEY)

for attempt in range(3):
    try:
        resp = client.text_generate(model_version="rwd-v1", input="Summarize this")
        break
    except TransientError:
        sleep(2 ** attempt)
        continue
```

laura: That looks fine. Replace `TransientError` with the actual exception type we raise (e.g., `RateLimitError`).

sam: I've skimmed the examples. Two small rename requests: `request id` -> `request identifier` in comments and sample payloads, and `metadata` keys should be snake_case in Python examples (e.g., `request_identifier`).

nisha: Will do. Any blocker for merging other than approvals and a clean CI?

emily: Timing question — do we want this merged before the release cut tomorrow? If it goes in right before the cut it may complicate backports.

laura: Prefer to merge at least 2 hours before release cut. If we can't get approvals by EOD today, queue for tomorrow morning between 9–11am PT.

mike: I can trigger a clean preview build tomorrow morning on merge window.

sam: I'll mark myself as reviewer and aim to finish checks before 10am PT.

nisha: Thanks all. I'll update the PR with the exact term changes and the retry snippet, then request review from @sam and @laura. Hold merge until docs-bot shows preview green and both reviews approved.

docs-bot: PR #4821 — review requested: sam, laura. CI: linkcheck pending, preview pending.
